beats.text: Your AI agent sends money from your bank account. You never asked it to. Who pays?
beats.dir: gripping, urgent hook, a real question

beats.text: One of America's biggest banks just answered — and it's not the bank.
Citi's new online terms say: if an outside AI agent logs in with your details, everything it does counts as authorized by you.
Even if it ignores your instructions.
Lend a friend your house keys. They throw a party. You get the bill.
And reports say other big banks are taking the same line.
Here's the catch: the rule doesn't cover Citi's own AI tools. Only outside ones.
And outside agents can be hijacked by a single hidden line on a webpage.
So before you hand any AI your bank login, ask one question: is it your bank's tool — or someone else's?
